problem.title: Smallest Index With Digit Sum Equal to Index

approaches.title: Linear scan with digit-sum matching
approaches.summary: Iterate through the numbers in index order, compute each number's digit sum, and return the first index where it matches. Return -1 when no index qualifies.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Implemented a direct loop that computes digit sums and returns the first matching index.
Refactored the scan to use iterator find_map while retaining the same digit-by-digit sum calculation.
Extracted digit-sum computation into a closure and used position with map_or to find the matching index.
Replaced the digit-sum loop with an iterator based on successors, preserving the same linear scan strategy.
